headline: Vote on land disposition agreement with Cabot, Cabot and Forbes, plus a tree committee ordinance and gas main replacements.
summary: Other items include a motion to freeze decisions on TIFs and TIEs and city responses on a skate park and an ADA sidewalk on Parker Street. A petition from Norma Von Fricken asks to speak about road conditions and traffic lights.
items: Remote and Zoom participation rules for the public
Motion to invite Lowell Housing Authority to present on Merrimack Street Corridor development
Motion to evaluate Hampshire Street for speed bumps
Motion to freeze decisions on TIFs and TIEs pending a sliding scale tax incentive package
City Manager response on ADA sidewalk on Parker Street
City Manager response on application process for utility companies
City Manager response on skate park
Vote to amend City Council rules
Vote to authorize City Manager to sign land disposition agreement with Cabot, Cabot and Forbes
Ordinance to amend Chapter 9 by creating Urban Forestry (Tree) Committee
Norma Von Fricken request to address council on road conditions and traffic lights
Boston Gas request to replace gas main on portions of Meadowcroft and Washer streets
Boston Gas request to replace gas main at 57 Lee Street
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA / Zoom (Hybrid)

Date:        November 17, 2026
Time: 6:30 PM
Location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA / Zoom (Hybrid)
ROLL CALL
MAYOR'S BUSINESS
Communication - Remote/Zoom Participation.
Meetings Will Be Held In Council Chamber With Public Welcome And By Using 
Remote Participation As Follows:  Members Of The Public May View The Meeting 
Via LTC.Org (On-Line; Live Streaming; Or Local Cable Channel 6).  Those Wishing 
To Speak Regarding A Specific Agenda Item Shall Register To Speak In Advance 
Of The Meeting By Sending Email To City Clerk Indicating The Agenda Item And A 
Phone Number To Call So That You May Be Issued Zoom Link To The Meeting. 
 Email Address Is MGEARY@LOWELLMA.GOV.  If No Access To Email You May 
Contact City Clerk At 978-674-4161.  All Request Must Be Done Before 4:00 PM 
On The Day Of Meeting.  For Zoom - HTTPS://SUPPORT.ZOOM.US/HC/EN-
US/ARTICLES/201362193-JOINING-A-MEETING

CITY COUNCIL - MOTIONS

November 24, 2026 To Provide A Presentation Regarding The Development Of The 
Merrimack Street Corridor. 
C. Robinson - Req. City Mgr. Have The Proper Department Evaluate Hampshire 
Street For The Feasibility Of Installing Speed Bumps. 
C. Robinson / M. Gitschier - Req. City Council Freeze All Decisions On TIFs And TIEs 
Pending The Creation Of A Sliding Scale Tax Incentive Package That Incorporates 
Community And Council Led Initiatives.
